# Empresa Online Portugal

> Agent Skill for starting a company in Portugal / criar empresa em Portugal through Empresa Online 2.0. Covers Lda. and sociedade unipessoal por quotas. Portuguese and English translations share one skill identity; choose one language directory.

## Load the skill

- [Português — SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/skills/pt/empresa-online-portugal/SKILL.md): Default for Portuguese requests, including criar empresa, abrir sociedade, Lda., unipessoal and Empresa na Hora online when the online service is intended.
- [English — SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/skills/en/empresa-online-portugal/SKILL.md): Company formation, incorporation and business registration in Portugal. Load this file and its relative references together.

## Installation

- [Portuguese setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/docs/instalar.pt.md): Direct language-specific skills CLI URL, Codex and Claude installation.
- [English setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/docs/install.en.md): Direct language-specific skills CLI URL, Codex and Claude installation.

## Workflow references

- [Percurso e fontes oficiais](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/skills/pt/empresa-online-portugal/references/percurso.md): Procedure, official sources, review dates and evidence boundaries.
- [Journey and official sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/skills/en/empresa-online-portugal/references/journey.md): Procedure, official sources, review dates and evidence boundaries.
- [Registo local privado](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/skills/pt/empresa-online-portugal/references/registo-local.md): Save/resume protocol and record template.
- [Private local working record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/skills/en/empresa-online-portugal/references/working-record.md): Save/resume protocol and record template.

## Scope and evidence

The assistant prepares proposals, operates available browser tools, reviews generated documents and resumes from a private local record. The person makes decisions and handles authentication, signatures and payment. Post-registration filings require a separate decision. This is not an official IRN service. Self-employed activity registration is a separate workflow.

- [Testing and limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hugo-alves/empresa-online-portugal/main/docs/testing.md): Behavioral exercises used fictional local forms/documents. The real public route was checked to authentication; authenticated end-to-end incorporation was not tested.
